E2-2024-T4-P1-S5.trunk: Existing health privacy law is focused on the way（现行健康隐私法主要关注这种方式）
structure: 主句：Existing health privacy law is primarily focused on the way
├ 插入举例：such as the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act
└ 定语从句〔省略that/in which，修饰 way〕：hospitals, doctors' offices, clinics and insurance companies store health records online
E2-2024-T4-P1-S5.logic: 句子核心是法律关注the way；中间such as给出法律实例，末尾从句具体说明受监管主体如何在线保存健康记录。
notes: be focused on 意为“重点关注”。
the way 后的关系词常被省略。
Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act 常简称HIPAA。

E2-2024-T4-P1-S10.trunk: Flo Health and the FTC settled the matter with a Consent Order（Flo Health与联邦贸易委员会以同意令和解）
structure: 主句：Flo Health and the FTC settled the matter with a Consent Order
└ 现在分词短语〔修饰 Consent Order〕：requiring the company
├ 宾补一：to get app users' express affirmative consent before sharing ...
└ 宾补二：as well as to instruct the third parties to delete the data
E2-2024-T4-P1-S10.logic: 主干交代和解方式；requiring说明同意令的两项要求，as well as连接取得同意和指示删数，that从句限定已被第三方获取的数据。
notes: Consent Order 是监管和解中的“同意令”。
express affirmative consent 指明确、主动作出的同意。
before sharing 的逻辑主语是 company。

E2-2024-T4-P1-S12.trunk: The rate demonstrates how immense a challenge this is（这种速度表明挑战极其艰巨）
structure: 让步状语从句(While)：While the FTC is doing what it can
└ 宾语从句：apps are keeping their promises to consumers around the handling of ... information
├ 定语从句(at which)：at which these health apps are hitting the market
└ 宾语从句：just how immense of a challenge this is
E2-2024-T4-P1-S12.logic: While承认监管机构正在尽力，主句随后转折指出应用上市速度揭示了问题规模；at which把rate与上市动作连接起来。
notes: do what it can 指“尽其所能”。
keep one's promises 指“兑现承诺”。
hit the market 意为“进入市场、上市”。
